ei.title: The limbic brain and nonverbal communication
ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought. For that reason, it gives off a true response to information coming in from the environment. Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. ( ) It is always "on." ( ) The limbic brain is also our emotional center. ( ) These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. ( ) Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine. ( ) Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals. * limbic brain 변연계 뇌 ** reflexively 반사적으로 *** torso 몸통

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival.

(A) For that reason, it gives off a true response to information coming in from the environment. Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks.

(B) In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought.

(C) It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center. These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine. Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals.

det.korean: 도입문에서 변연계 뇌가 신호를 보내 행동을 조율한다고 소개한 후, (B)에서 비언어 연구에서 변연계가 핵심인 이유를 설명하고, (A)에서 그래서(For that reason) 진정한 반응을 내보낸다고 이어지며, (C)에서 항상 켜져 있고 정직한 뇌라는 결론으로 마무리된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ② (B)-(A)-(C): 도입문 'signals go out... orchestrate our behaviors' → (B) 'In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? Because it... reacts... reflexively' — 변연계의 핵심 역할 소개 → (A) 'For that reason' — (B)에서 반사적으로 반응한다고 했으므로 그것이 이유가 됨 → 'does not take breaks' → (C) 'It is always "on."' — 쉬지 않는다는 말에 이어 항상 켜져 있다로 연결 → 'the "honest brain"' 결론

❌ ① (A)-(C)-(B): 'For that reason'이 도입문과 직접 연결되지 않음. 도입문에는 이유가 제시되지 않았음
❌ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): (C)의 'It is always "on."'이 (A)의 'does not take breaks' 앞에 와야 자연스러움
❌ ④ (C)-(A)-(B): (C)의 'It is always "on."'이 갑자기 등장하면 맥락 없음
det.tip: 지시어 추적: 'For that reason'은 앞 문장의 근거를 받는 연결어. (B)의 'reacts reflexively and instantaneously'가 그 이유에 해당

questions.stem:
주어진 글 다음에 이어질 글의 순서로 가장 적절한 것은?

It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is.

(A) These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine.

(B) Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought. For that reason, it gives off a true response to information coming in from the environment.

(C) Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center.

det.korean: 도입문 '비언어 연구에서 변연계가 핵심'이라는 말 뒤에 (B) '왜냐하면(Why? Because)' 이유 설명이 이어지고, (C)에서 '생존에 책임이 있어 쉬지 않는다'로 확장하며, (A)에서 'These behaviors(이러한 행동들)'가 (C)의 'emotional center'와 연결되어 관찰 가능하다고 마무리된다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③ (B)-(C)-(A): 도입문 '...the limbic brain is where the action is.' → (B) 'Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts...' — 의문사 Why가 앞 문장을 직접 받음 → 'For that reason, it gives off a true response' → (C) 'Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center.' — 생존 책임 → 쉬지 않음 → 감정 중심 → (A) 'These behaviors can be observed and decoded' — 'These behaviors'는 (C)에서 언급된 감정 중심 역할에서 비롯된 행동 지칭

❌ ① (A)-(B)-(C): 'These behaviors'가 도입문 뒤에 바로 오면 지시 대상 불명확
❌ ② (B)-(A)-(C): (A)의 'These behaviors'가 (B)의 'true response' 바로 뒤에 오면 부자연스러움
❌ ④ (C)-(B)-(A): 'Why?'가 (C) 뒤에 오면 질문의 대상이 없음
det.tip: 지시대명사 'These'는 앞 문장에서 구체적으로 언급된 내용을 받는다. 'emotional center' 다음에 그 행동들이 물리적으로 나타난다는 연결이 자연스럽다.

questions.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? Not only does it react to the outside world, but it also generates emotions that are reflected in our body language.
questions.passage: It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? (④) Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine. Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals.

det.korean:
주어진 문장: '변연계는 외부 세계에 반응할 뿐만 아니라, 몸짓 언어에 반영되는 감정도 생성한다.'
이 문장은 감정 생성과 신체적 표현을 연결하는 내용이므로, 'emotional center(감정 중심)'와 'These behaviors can be observed... physically(이러한 행동들이 신체적으로 관찰됨)' 사이인 ③에 들어가야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ③: 앞 문장 'The limbic brain is also our emotional center.' — 감정 중심이라는 언급 → 주어진 문장 'Not only does it react... but it also generates emotions that are reflected in our body language' — 감정이 몸짓 언어에 반영된다는 구체화 → 뒤 문장 'These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically' — 'These behaviors'가 주어진 문장의 'body language'를 지칭하며 자연스럽게 연결

❌ ① 'does not take breaks' 뒤: 쉬지 않는다는 맥락과 감정 생성은 무관
❌ ② 'always on' 뒤: 항상 켜져 있다는 말 바로 뒤에 감정 생성이 오면 논리적 비약
❌ ④ 'manifest physically in our feet...' 뒤: 이미 신체 표현을 설명한 후이므로 주어진 문장이 중복됨
det.tip: 문장삽입은 '지시어 추적'이 핵심. 'These behaviors'가 가리킬 수 있는 내용이 바로 앞에 와야 한다.

questions.stem: 글의 흐름으로 보아, 주어진 문장이 들어가기에 가장 적절한 곳은? This is precisely why it serves as a reliable window into a person's thoughts and feelings.
questions.passage: It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought. For that reason, it gives off a true response to information coming in from the environment. (①) Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. (②) It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center. These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. (③) Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine. (④) Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals.

det.korean:
주어진 문장: '이것이 바로 변연계가 사람의 생각과 감정에 대한 믿을 수 있는 창으로 기능하는 이유이다.'
'reactions... are genuine(반응이 진짜이다)' 뒤에 와서 'This is precisely why(이것이 바로 ~인 이유)'로 근거를 받고, 이어서 'Thus(따라서)... the "honest brain"'이라는 최종 결론으로 이어진다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④: 앞 문장 'Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine.' — 반응이 사고 없이 일어나므로 진짜라는 근거 → 주어진 문장 'This is precisely why it serves as a reliable window...' — 진짜이기 때문에 믿을 수 있는 창이라는 결론 도출 → 뒤 문장 'Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain"' — 최종 결론(정직한 뇌)

❌ ① 'true response' 뒤: 아직 행동 관찰/진짜라는 논거가 나오기 전이므로 'This'의 지시 대상 부족
❌ ② 'does not take breaks' 뒤: 쉬지 않는다는 사실만으로 reliable window라는 결론은 비약
❌ ③ 'manifest physically' 뒤: 관찰 가능하다는 것과 reliable window 사이에 'genuine'이라는 핵심 근거가 빠짐
det.tip: 'This is precisely why'는 앞 문장의 내용을 이유로 결론을 도출하는 표현. 바로 앞에 충분한 근거가 있어야 한다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.passage: It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, ①<u>which</u> in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought. For that reason, it gives off a true response to information ②<u>coming</u> in from the environment. Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center. These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest ③<u>physical</u> in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine. Thus, the limbic brain is ④<u>considered</u> the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals.

det.korean: ③ physical → physically: 동사 manifest를 수식하는 부사가 필요하므로 형용사 physical이 아닌 부사 physically가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① which: 'parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate' — 계속적 용법 관계대명사. 선행사 'parts of the brain' 전체를 부연 설명. 정상

❌ ② coming: 'information coming in from the environment' — 현재분사가 information을 후치 수식. '환경에서 들어오는 정보'. 정상

✅ ③ physical: 'manifest physical in our feet' — manifest(나타나다)는 자동사로 쓰였고, 부사 수식이 필요함. 형용사 physical(물리적인)이 아닌 부사 physically(물리적으로)가 와야 함 ← 정답

❌ ④ considered: 'the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain"' — be considered + 보어(5형식 수동태). 정상
det.tip: 동사를 꾸미는 것은 부사. manifest(나타나다) + physically(물리적으로). 형용사는 명사를 수식하거나 보어로 쓰인다.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.passage: It is from there ①<u>that</u> signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is ②<u>where</u> the action is. Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought. For that reason, it gives off a true response to information coming in from the environment. Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center. These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. Since these reactions ③<u>occur</u> without thought, unlike words, they are genuine. Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of ④<u>nonverbal</u>.

det.korean: ④ nonverbal → nonverbals: 'think of' 뒤에 목적어(명사)가 필요하며, 여기서 nonverbals는 '비언어적 신호들'이라는 명사(복수형)이므로 형용사 nonverbal이 아닌 복수명사 nonverbals가 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① that: 'It is from there that signals go out' — 강조구문(It is ~ that ...). 'from there'를 강조하기 위해 It is ... that 구문 사용. 정상

❌ ② where: 'the limbic brain is where the action is' — 관계부사 where가 보어절을 이끌며 '~하는 곳'이라는 의미. 정상

❌ ③ occur: 'Since these reactions occur without thought' — 주어 reactions(복수)에 동사 occur(복수형) 일치. 정상

✅ ④ nonverbal: 'when we think of nonverbal' — 'think of' 뒤에는 명사(목적어)가 필요. nonverbal은 형용사이므로 명사형 nonverbals(비언어적 신호들)가 와야 함 ← 정답
det.tip: 전치사 of 뒤에는 명사(구)가 와야 한다. nonverbals = 비언어적 표현들(명사). nonverbal = 비언어적인(형용사). 강조구문 It is ~ that도 함께 점검 포인트.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?
questions.passage: It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn ①<u>orchestrate</u> our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought. For that reason, it gives off a true response to information coming in from the environment. Because it is uniquely ②<u>responsibly</u> for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center. These behaviors can be ③<u>observed</u> and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are ④<u>genuine</u>. Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals.

det.korean: ② responsibly → responsible: 'it is responsible for'에서 be동사 뒤에 보어(형용사)가 필요하므로 부사 responsibly가 아닌 형용사 responsible이 와야 한다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① orchestrate: 'parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors' — 선행사 parts(복수)를 받는 계속적 용법 관계대명사 which + 복수동사 orchestrate. 정상

✅ ② responsibly: 'it is uniquely responsibly for our survival' — be동사의 보어 자리에는 형용사가 와야 함. responsibly(책임감 있게)는 부사이므로 형용사 responsible(책임이 있는)이 맞음. uniquely는 형용사 responsible을 수식하는 부사 ← 정답

❌ ③ observed: 'can be observed and decoded' — 조동사+수동태(can be+p.p.) 병렬구조. 정상

❌ ④ genuine: 'they are genuine' — be동사 뒤 형용사 보어. 정상
det.tip: be동사 + 보어 = 형용사. 부사(responsibly)는 보어 자리에 올 수 없다. cf. uniquely responsible에서 uniquely(부사)가 responsible(형용사)을 수식하는 구조.

The limbic brain is also our emotional center. These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. Since these reactions occur without thought, unlike words, they are genuine. Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals.

det.korean: Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival — 변연계 뇌가 우리 생존에 대해 고유한 책임이 있기 때문에
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- Because(접속사: ~때문에) + it(주어: 변연계 뇌) + is(be동사) + uniquely(부사: 고유하게) + responsible(형용사: 책임이 있는) + for(전치사) + our survival(목적어: 우리의 생존)
- 'be responsible for ~' = ~에 대해 책임이 있다
- uniquely는 형용사 responsible을 수식하는 부사
- 접속사 Because가 이끄는 부사절이 주절(the limbic brain does not take breaks) 앞에 위치
det.tip: be responsible for는 자주 출제되는 구문. uniquely(부사)가 responsible(형용사) 앞에 위치하여 수식하는 구조에 주의.

questions.passage: It is from there that signals go out to various other parts of the brain, which in turn orchestrate our behaviors as they relate to emotions or our survival. In our study of nonverbal communications, the limbic brain is where the action is. Why? Because it is the part of the brain that reacts to the world around us reflexively and instantaneously, in real time, and without thought. For that reason, it gives off a true response to information coming in from the environment. Because it is uniquely responsible for our survival, the limbic brain does not take breaks. It is always "on." The limbic brain is also our emotional center. These behaviors can be observed and decoded as they manifest physically in our feet, torsos, arms, hands, and faces. __________, unlike words, they are genuine. Thus, the limbic brain is considered the "honest brain" when we think of nonverbals.

det.korean: Since these reactions occur without thought — 이러한 반응들이 사고 없이 일어나기 때문에
det.analysis:
구문 분석:
- Since(접속사: ~이므로/~때문에) + these reactions(주어: 이러한 반응들) + occur(동사: 일어나다) + without thought(전치사구: 사고 없이)
- Since가 이끄는 이유절이 주절 앞에 위치
- occur without thought: '사고(과정) 없이 발생하다'
- 뒤에 이어지는 'unlike words, they are genuine'에서 unlike words는 삽입구
det.tip: Since = Because (이유). 접속사 since가 이끄는 부사절 + 주절 구조. occur(자동사)는 목적어 없이 바로 전치사구와 결합.
